url.description: The absolute URL to the REST service

contractFirst.description: Whether the REST service is contract-first

specification.description: Whether this is the API contract specification (i.e. api-doc)

routeId.description: The route ID (only present when known)

operationId.description: The OpenAPI operation ID (only present for contract-first routes)

specificationUri.description: The OpenAPI specification URI (only present for contract-first routes)

consumes.description: The accepted media types (only present when known)

produces.description: The returned media types (only present when known)

inType.description: The input binding class name (only present when known)

outType.description: The output binding class name (only present when known)

description.description: The REST service description (only present when configured)

hits.description: Usage of the REST service (only present when greater than zero)

rests.description: The REST services (only present when a REST registry is available)
